description: Schema synchronization utility for Neon PostgreSQL, managing database schema for roles, competencies, role_competencies, and role_adjacency tables with idempotent SQL statements.

methods.name: _exec_batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of SQL statements, returning count of executed statements and errors.

methods.name: _ensure_roles
methods.description: Ensures the 'roles' table and indexes exist.

methods.name: _ensure_competencies
methods.description: Ensures the 'competencies' table and indexes exist.

methods.name: _ensure_role_competencies
methods.description: Ensures the 'role_competencies' table, foreign keys, and indexes exist.

methods.name: _ensure_role_adjacency
methods.description: Ensures the 'role_adjacency' table, foreign keys, and indexes exist.

methods.name: run_schema_sync
methods.description: Runs the full schema synchronization process, returning status and errors.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to execute schema sync and print logs.
